name: Quick Sigorta A.S.
summary: Quick Sigorta A.S. provides non-life insurance services in Turkey. The company offers vehicle, home, health, workplace, life, travel, and financial insurance services. It also provides identity protection, drone (UAV), personal accident, extreme sports, and medical malpractice insurances. The company was formerly known as Erdemoglu Sigorta A.S. Quick Sigorta A.S. was founded in 2015 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
